latest_release.name: Release v1.5.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix(server): send a request's notifications on its POST stream by @QuentinBisson in https://github.com/mark3labs/mcp-go/pull/1117
* fix(server): bound the request body read by the SSE message endpoint by @QuentinBisson in https://github.com/mark3labs/mcp-go/pull/1119
* fix(client): bound the messages the HTTP transports read from the server by @QuentinBisson in https://github.com/mark3labs/mcp-go/pull/1121
* fix(oauth): accept case variants of localhost redirect hosts by @ezynda3 in https://github.com/mark3labs/mcp-go/pull/1125
* fix(stdio): cancel tool calls still waiting for a worker by @jaeminbird in https://github.com/mark3labs/mcp-go/pull/1129
* feat(client): add WithManualInputRoundTrips for caller-driven input by @dougkirkley in https://github.com/mark3labs/mcp-go/pull/1132
* fix(stdio): answer tool calls still queued when input ends by @sarankumar1325 in https://github.com/mark3labs/mcp-go/pull/1134
* fix(server): refuse subscriptions/listen when the response cannot stream by @zerone0x in https://github.com/mark3labs/mcp-go/pull/1138

## New Contributors
* @jaeminbird made their first contribution in https://github.com/mark3labs/mcp-go/pull/1129
* @dougkirkley made their first contribution in https://github.com/mark3labs/mcp-go/pull/1132
* @sarankumar1325 made their first contribution in https://github.com/mark3labs/mcp-go/pull/1134
* @zerone0x made their first contribution in https://github.com/mark3labs/mcp-go/pull/1138

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/mark3labs/mcp-go/compare/v1.4.0...v1.5.0
